styles.casual: casual and short, like a quick chat message to a colleague
styles.rushed: rushed, all lower case, with one or two small typos and little punctuation
styles.wordy: long and wordy, with a sentence of background about why they are asking
styles.email: a polite, formal email with a greeting and a sign-off
styles.plain_english: simple English from someone whose first language is not English
styles.keywords: very short, just the key words, not a full sentence
styles.indirect: indirect: describes the situation and implies the question instead of asking it outright
styles.synonyms: different words for the same things (e.g. 'USMCA' or 'the trade agreement' for CUSMA, 'footwear' for boots, 'tariff' for duty)
styles.outside_view: from the point of view of a customer or partner outside the company
styles.french: in French, as a French-speaking Canadian would write it
